head.h1: Film Crew Catering in Dubai — What It Costs and How to Book

opening_paragraph: Film crew catering Dubai from myCHEF starts at AED 700 per person, keeping cast and crew fed through long shoot days with hot meals, all-day craft service and a chef who times every break to your call sheet. Send us your dates, unit size and venue, we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, with a full itemised quote to follow: breakfasts, hot lunches, snacks and dietary-aware crew meals, all built around your schedule and every department on set.

new_paragraphs: Film crew catering includes the meals, the craft service and the on-set logistics as one managed service: hot breakfasts and lunches, all-day snacks and drinks, plus a vetted chef, service or delivery, setup and cleanup. As a full film crew catering services provider, myCHEF designs the menu with your production, brings everything the base camp needs and works to the call sheet so meal breaks land on time and the AD never has to chase a hot lunch. Unlike a supermarket run or a cold sandwich drop, a private film crew chef cooks on site, holds food at temperature and paces service around setups so nothing goes to waste between takes. Whether it is a small unit of eight or a hundred-strong cast and crew, one team owns the timing from the 6am breakfast to the wrap snack. Every film crew catering company promises to feed a set; our difference is a real chef standing behind the line, not just a van at the gate.
How much does film crew catering cost in Dubai?

From AED 700 per person, quoted by headcount, menu and shoot length. Craft service and drop-off sit at the lower end; hot staffed on-set service sits higher. Packages from AED 1,200 suit fixed unit sizes. Send your call sheet for an itemised quote.
What is included in film crew catering?

Included is a vetted chef, on-set service or delivery, all-day craft service, setup and cleanup, plus bespoke menu design from the first conversation. Everything is timed to your call sheet so meal breaks land on schedule.
Can you handle dietary needs on set?

Yes. Crew meals can be built vegan, gluten-free, nut-free, keto or halal, with meat prepared to halal standards on request, so every department eats well from the same service. Share needs when you enquire.
Do you cater corporate productions and branded shoots?

Yes. Corporate film crew catering in Dubai covers commercials, brand films, product launches and multi-day campaigns, scaled from a small unit to a full cast-and-crew production with a separate client table.
Is there film crew catering near me across Dubai?
Yes. We cover the whole emirate, from desert and beach units to Studio City stages, warehouse sets and city rooftops, reaching your base camp wherever the shoot is.
Do you offer film crew catering packages?

Yes. Per-head pricing suits single days, while set packages from AED 1,200 and retained multi-day programmes work well for fixed unit sizes and longer schedules. We point you to whichever gives better value.
How do I book or set up a regular arrangement?
Tell us your dates, unit size and call times; we send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day, and can set up consistent menus and simplified billing for a run of shoot days.
For film crew catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

We provide film crew catering across Dubai, from desert and beach units to Studio City stages, warehouse sets, city rooftops and hotel locations. The service travels to your base camp, which is why the "near me" question is about reach — and ours covers the whole emirate, indoors or out. A sunrise desert shoot, a corporate commercial in a Business Bay office and a music video on a Marina yacht all run on the same standard: a vetted chef, hot on-time meals and full craft service. Planning around the production? See our production catering and corporate event catering , or browse the full range of catering in Dubai . Wherever the location scout lands, the best film crew catering meets you there, ready before the first crew member signs in.
